tonight.headline: Three coin flips set the wrong way, and a Thursday question
body: Bad news first. Jonathan Taylor is on the trade block — a deal is 'more likely than not' before 10 Nov (Schultz via RotoWire 1 Nov) — and the NFL is reviewing three new allegations against Josh Jacobs (PFT 31 Oct). Neither has a date. Bhayshul Tuten, in the FLEX, did not practise Monday and plays Thursday night.

As set, Bloodsports project 130.2 to Jackrabbits' 123.5. The projection lineup is 133.5: Gordon for Tuten in the FLEX before Thursday 19:15 CDMX, Rice for Wilson and Likely for Loveland before Sunday. All three are coin flips — take the projection, no thesis.

case.label: Their lineup
case.body: Jackrabbits start Burrow 20.4 with Brock Purdy 21.4 on their bench, and carry DK Metcalf on bye. Bijan 18.8, Jeanty 14.7 — and Jeanty lost the carries to Mike Washington Jr. last week by Kubiak's design (RotoWire 1 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Bloodsports set the projection lineup and still lose by more than 10 — then it was the roster, not the lineup.

doFirst.title: Start Gordon in the FLEX, bench Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: 16.5 to 15.4 — a coin flip the projection takes, and it moves a questionable player out of Thursday night.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Gordon 16.5, Tuten 15.4: inside two points. Take the projection; no thesis.

case.label: Why before Thursday
case.body: Tuten did not practise Monday (ankle/foot; Jaguars.com, RotoWire 2 Nov) and plays at Baltimore, 4th-toughest against backs. Once Jacksonville kick off he is locked into the FLEX.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten outscores Gordon in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Rice, bench Garrett Wilson
doFirst.subtitle: 13.9 to 12.7 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Rice 13.9, Wilson 12.7: inside two points.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Rice practised fully and 'looks 100% healthy' (CBS 2 Nov). Wilson drew 12 targets but goes to Kansas City, 2nd-toughest on WRs (StatChasers). Neither is a reason; the number is.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson outscores Rice in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Likely at TE, bench Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: 12.8 to 11.8 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Likely 12.8, Loveland 11.8: inside two points.

case.label: Against it
case.body: Loveland drew 9 targets Monday night and Kmet is out for the season (RotoWire 2 Nov; NBC 23 Oct); Likely goes to Philadelphia, 4th-toughest on TEs. Matchups are not overrides.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland outscores Likely in Week 9 (archive).

whatWentWrong.title: The lineup carried three coin flips the wrong way
whatWentWrong.lead: 3.3 projected points unset, one of them on a questionable player who locks Thursday.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Week 8's lineup carried over. Likely is back from his bye, Rice is healthy, Gordon edges Tuten.

case.label: The fix
case.body: The three lineup cards above, Tuten's first.

case.label: Falsified if

whatWentWrong.title: Week 8 left 11.6 on the bench, not 4.2
whatWentWrong.lead: Rice's 18.3 sat while Taylor's 6.7 started; last night's brief under-counted it.

case.label: The arithmetic
case.body: Best lineup from the archive: Tuten and Jacobs at RB, Golden and Rice at WR, Wilson in the FLEX — Rice for Taylor, 11.6. The earlier figure compared slot by slot.

case.label: Whose call
case.body: The projection's: Taylor 15.7, Rice 12.7. No override; nothing to change.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The archive totals differ from the ones used here.

roster.footnote: No Week 9 game has started. Rows show the lineup as set; verdicts show the projection lineup. Grades are rank in points allowed to the position, StatChasers weeks 1-8 (1 = toughest).

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 3.3 below the projection lineup across three coin flips — Gordon over Tuten, Rice over Wilson, Likely over Loveland; take the projection on all three.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: Kubiak's design, not an injury — a free-agent look only if it repeats.

case.label: The player
case.body: 25 carries for 83; Jeanty 2 carries and 64 receiving. Kubiak: 'by design', Jeanty 'still going to be a big part' (RotoWire 1 Nov).

case.label: Why not
case.body: IPADE priority never resets and Bloodsports carry four startable backs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco and still unrostered after claims clear — a free agent then, no priority spent.

worthALook.name: Tyler Allgeier
worthALook.lead: Love out 2-3 weeks; Allgeier has the job at Seattle.

case.label: The vacancy
case.body: Love's third ankle injury, 2-3 weeks per SI (2 Nov); Allgeier ~70% of the rushing snaps.

case.label: Why not
case.body: A claim costs IPADE priority for the season; he would be a fifth back. 36.1 came on 16 touches.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Taylor traded into a committee or Jacobs suspended — then a starter-level need, and only if he clears to free agency.

doNotChase.name: Patrick Mahomes
doNotChase.lead: Healthy and on waivers — and not better than Daniels this week.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 17.4 against Daniels 18.7; a claim drops Bloodsports to last for the season. Mahomes threw for 300+ and 3 TD last week (Yahoo 2 Nov) — no injury, a league quirk.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Daniels injury, or Mahomes clearing to free agency for nothing.

case.label: What would change it

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Montgomery ruled out and Jacobs suspended.

case.label: The number that kills it

case.label: What would change it
